material.acceptance_criteria: A right press that play.js treats as an orbit issues no order on release. The camera-drag threshold and the pack's click threshold come from one value, or the pack ignores right releases that followed a moved drag.
material.description: play.js:57 sets DRAG_SLOP_PX = 4, and play.js:1223 marks a right-button drag as moved after 4 px. That drag orbits the camera (play.js:1227). play.js:1236 forwards every pointer up to the pack, whatever the drag state. The pack decides 'moved' in ground tiles: controls.lua:481 compares the press and release points with CFG.dragSlop, which is 0.25 (controls.lua:37, moba_ui.json:62). When the release is not moved, controls.lua:482-490 calls order_selected for a right click. The screen centre stays fixed while the view yaws, and the ground under other pixels moves about r*dyaw, so a 4-10 px orbit near the centre reads as a click. Symptom: nudging the camera with the right button walks the selected units to the release point.
material.subject: A short right-drag that orbits the camera also issues a move order on release
material.witness: Re-checked on origin/main (ci-status eec4a2ce: 6/6 success, run 40112898029). play.js:1234-1237 drops the pointerup forward to the pack when the right drag moved (DRAG_SLOP_PX=4, play.js:57), so the pack takes no order for a moved release. Witness dispatch 1792860191938-6776-e56cae65407e6aa3 from its own session. Row resolved on the fix sha eec4a2ce, an ancestor of origin/main.
